messages:
Carmen (SE): Heads-up: customer HelioBank dropped an SQ this morning asking for RBAC change audit evidence, KMS rotation proofs, and vuln triage notes. They want an export suitable for their external auditors before tomorrow's security review call.
Alice (InfoSec): Got it. Do we have a packaged artifact set (export + manifest + attestation) we can hand them? Should include retention policy and chain-of-custody notes.
Ben (SRE): We have an export script that covers auth/roles/kms. Example: 
```
/scripts/export_audit.sh --tenant=heliobank --since=365d --types=auth,roles,kms --out=/tmp/helio-audit.tar.gz
```
It needs verification that role-change and service-account ops are included.
Carmen (SE): Helio asked specifically for proof that RBAC changes are auditable and immutable and that KMS rotations are envelope-wrapped and logged. Also asked if logs can be shipped to their SIEM.
Jake (Infra): For hosted customers we don't ship tenant logs directly to customer SIEM by default. We can either provide a signed, redacted export bundle or for Dedicated/Private offer a forwarder config. For the bundle we include signed manifest (SHA256) + MD5 and a signer identity.
Priya (Solutions): Can we add a README to the bundle that explains field names, redaction rules, and the retention window? Helio's auditors will need that.
Alice (InfoSec): Yes. README should contain: generation command, manifest with checksums, signing principal (redwood-audit-key), redaction policy (PII fields removed), retention window, and contact for chain-of-custody questions.
Ben (SRE): I'll generate the manifest and sign it with the audit key. sec-bot, queue the export job.
sec-bot: export job queued: job-id=jb-20260321-42 tenant=heliobank
sec-bot: job started by Ben (SRE) at 2026-03-21T14:12:03Z
Carmen (SE): One more Helio ask: show the KMS rotation event(s) and wrapping key lineage for the last 12 months; HSM provenance if applicable to their pilot.
Jake (Infra): For our managed KMS we can include kms.rotation.* events, key metadata (key-id, created_at, rotated_at), and envelope chain entries. HSM-onprem provenance lives in ops' HSM audit system, needs a separate export. I'll ping Ops to pull HSM logs.
Alice (InfoSec): Also confirm whether rotation is automatic or manual per tenant; Helio will map this to a control.
Priya (Solutions): Suggested wording for customer materials: "Rotation policy: default 90 days; customers may opt into managed rotation with HSM-backed keys (Dedicated/Private)." Can legal/infra weigh in on that phrasing?
Ben (SRE): Addendum: audit export includes actor identity (svc vs human) for rotation events. We'll keep emails redacted and preserve stable unique IDs.
Carmen (SE): Helio also wants a short demo of the RBAC approval flow (screenshots or short screencap) plus the matching system log events when an admin elevates a user.
Alice (InfoSec): Avoid screenshots containing PII. Provide sanitized screenshots and the corresponding audit events. Example event: `ROLE_CHANGE` {actor: svc-admin-42, target: user:helio-admin, from: viewer, to: admin, ts: 2026-01-11T09:22:33Z}.
Ben (SRE): I'll include that event JSON (with redacted fields) in the bundle.
Jake (Infra): Ops replied: HSM export for the pilot cluster is scheduled for 2026-03-22 08:00 PT, might slip. If Helio needs HSM provenance during the call, we should provide the signed bundle now and commit to delivering HSM artifacts within 48 hours.
Carmen (SE): I'll inform Helio we'll send the initial signed bundle before the call and HSM provenance as a follow-up if needed in-call.
Priya (Solutions): Action items & timeline: Ben to produce bundle + README by EOD today; Jake to confirm HSM export ETA; Alice to draft attestation email template (signed by security@redwood).
Ben (SRE): Working on it now. Export running. Will post location when finished.
sec-bot: export job completed: job-id=jb-20260321-42 out=/secure/exports/helio-audit-20260321.tar.gz checksum=sha256:3f7a9b0c5d... signed-by=redwood-audit-key
Ben (SRE): Bundle ready at /secure/exports/helio-audit-20260321.tar.gz. Permissions: internal/sec only; signed manifest included.
Carmen (SE): Sending initial bundle to Helio. Also they asked about CVE-2025-9999 triage history and mitigation timeline.
Alice (InfoSec): Suggested summary for auditors: "CVE-2025-9999: patched 2025-06-10; mitigations included code fix (v2.4.1), configuration hardening, and host-level detection rules. Verification: internal regression tests + rollout verification logs available on request." Keep internal deliberations out of the customer artifact; provide a concise timeline and patch reference.
Priya (Solutions): Helio will probably accept the timeline + patch ver and verification steps. No need for internal notes.
Jake (Infra): Ops ETA for HSM export: 2026-03-22T08:30Z. Will update thread with upload when complete.
Alice (InfoSec): Drafting attestation email template now; will include signer, manifest checksum, and contact for chain-of-custody.
Carmen (SE): Thanks everyone. I'll run the caller materials with the bundle link and the CVE summary. Ping @here if anything slips. :thumbsup:
